[resources/work-templates/assets/_helpers/README.md#convert-to-word-helper]

# Convert to Word Helper

This script converts Markdown files to Word documents (DOCX) with consistent Arial font formatting.
page_texts.4:
[resources/work-templates/assets/_helpers/README.md#process-all-folders]

### Process All Folders

Convert all markdown files in all assets subfolders (skips existing DOCX):

```powershell
python convert_to_word.py
```
page_texts.5:
[resources/work-templates/assets/_helpers/README.md#process-specific-folder]

### Process Specific Folder

Convert markdown files in a specific subfolder only:

```powershell
python convert_to_word.py artifacts
python convert_to_word.py governance
python convert_to_word.py sales
python convert_to_word.py workshop
```
page_texts.6:
[resources/work-templates/assets/_helpers/README.md#regenerate-mode]

### Regenerate Mode

Force regeneration of all DOCX files (even if they already exist):

```powershell
# Regenerate all folders
python convert_to_word.py regen

# Regenerate specific folder
python convert_to_word.py artifacts regen
python convert_to_word.py governance regen
```
page_texts.7:
[resources/work-templates/assets/_helpers/README.md#features]

## Features

- ✅ **Skip Existing**: By default, skips files where DOCX already exists
- ✅ **Regenerate Mode**: Use `regen` parameter to force recreation of all DOCX files
- ✅ **Arial Font**: All content uses Arial font (11pt for body, styled for headings)
- ✅ **Gainwell Branding**: Cover page with Gainwell logo, tables use green headers (#006633)
- ✅ **Professional Cover Page**: Auto-generated cover with logo, document title, and date
- ✅ **Footers**: All pages include footer with filename and generation date
- ✅ **Markdown Support**: Handles headers, lists, tables, blockquotes, checkboxes
- ✅ **Progress Tracking**: Shows detailed progress with emojis and summaries
- ✅ **Batch Processing**: Process single folder or all folders at once
page_texts.8:
[resources/work-templates/assets/_helpers/README.md#output]

## Output

The script provides visual feedback:

- 📄 **Processing**: Creating new DOCX file
- 🔄 **Regenerating**: Recreating existing DOCX file
- ⏭️ **Skip**: DOCX already exists (not in regen mode)
- ✅ **Created**: Successfully created DOCX file
- ❌ **Error**: Failed to process file
page_texts.9:
[resources/work-templates/assets/_helpers/README.md#examples]

## Examples

```powershell
# First run - creates all missing DOCX files
python convert_to_word.py

# Update only governance templates
python convert_to_word.py governance regen

# Process artifacts folder for the first time
python convert_to_word.py artifacts
```
page_texts.10:
[resources/work-templates/assets/_helpers/README.md#summary-reports]

## Summary Reports

The script provides summaries after processing:

- Per-folder summary (when processing specific folder or all folders)
- Overall summary (when processing all folders)
- Counts of processed, skipped, and error files

```
│   └── *.docx               # Generated Word documents
├── governance/
│   ├── *.md
│   └── *.docx
├── sales/
│   ├── *.md
│   └── *.docx

```
